notes.title: Milo and the Magpies Release & 40% OFF Rusty Lake!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623373/c69de201142c340b15a314b8bb90cefe70f4c083.png[/img]

We’re so proud of Johan Scherft, who made the amazing background painting of Rusty Lake: Roots and more! And now he just released his first game: Milo and the Magpies 😻

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1407420/Milo_and_the_Magpies/

Can you guide Milo back home? 🐈 

[previewyoutube=9BR1pPYA_Zs;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re more than honored to be part of his journey through our publishing program [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/secondmaze]Second Maze[/url] and we hope you will support him as well 🙏

To celebrate Johan's first ever release, we also launched a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3669/Rusty_Lake_Bundle/]40% OFF sale on all our premium games[/url]!

notes.title: Cube Escape Collection - Release date + Trailer
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33593611/7840c5679b78faccf1deb65fa216558498b198a9.jpg[/img]

Finally! The Cube Escape Collection will be released on October 14th on Steam!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R6RUyC-w9Lk

Follow the path of Dale, Laura and other Rusty lake characters like Mr. Crow and Mr. Owl in this classic point-and-click adventure anthology! The nine Cube Escape games are updated (achievements / hints / translations), preserved and bundled to survive the end of the Flash Games era.

Thanks for your support 🖤

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection

Art by Sevenix!

notes.title: The White Door - New Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35675864/5e57da3a2a23ce8b30afed9384bec9bea378f52e.png[/img]

Dear fans,

unfortunately due personal circumstances we have to postpone the release date of The White Door to January 9. The past weeks we were unable to work as we are used too, leaving no other option to take a bit more time.

We strongly believe delaying the game will be better for our wellbeing but also the quality of the game, as we would normally crunch the last 4 weeks to the release date (and the weeks after). Not releasing any game this year makes us sad, but knowing what awesome projects we have in the pipeline, we are sure we will not let you down next year.

Thanks for your support and all your wishlists so far!
